WITH income_member_major AS (
  SELECT i.amount, ma.college
  FROM income i
  INNER JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
  INNER JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
),
college_totals AS (
  SELECT college, SUM(amount) as college_sum
  FROM income_member_major
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY college
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(college_sum) as total_amount
  FROM college_totals
)
SELECT 
  ct.college,
  ct.college_sum,
  CASE 
    WHEN gt.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND gt.total_amount != 0 
    THEN CAST(ct.college_sum AS REAL) / gt.total_amount
    ELSE NULL
  END as ratio
FROM college_totals ct
CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
WHERE ct.college_sum IS NOT NULL AND gt.total_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ct.college
